limits: Embedded certificate text alone does not establish control of the corresponding private key or authenticity of package data.

Native trust output does not by itself document fresh online revocation queries. No independent revocation or notarization check is currently claimed.
The later full-package SHA256 is a local custody fingerprint unless a publisher checksum is independently supplied.
